$comment: Dated price-change notices (#710). The Terms promise that a running subscription keeps the price it started at, and that if one ever has to move, the household's admins are emailed at least 14 days before the new price takes effect. backend/tests/unit/config/priceChangeNotice.test.ts scans backend/src for every Stripe call that can change what a running subscription is charged (the list is in backend/tests/unit/config/priceChangeNoticeGate.ts) and fails unless each call is covered here by a notice whose effectiveOn is at least 14 days after emailedOn and has already arrived. Record a notice after the email has gone out, never before: emailedOn is an owner attestation, because no test can see an inbox. `sites` names the file (relative to backend/src), the surface and the number of calls the change adds; leave it empty while the email is out and the code is not written yet. When the change is finished and its code removed, set "retired": true rather than deleting the entry. Empty today because nothing in backend/src can move a running subscription onto a different price. A new price for NEW subscriptions needs no entry: the Terms say it applies only to them.
